text: It is too expensive for me.
I understand. A 3 kW rooftop system costs 1,95,000 rupees before the government subsidy of 78,000 rupees, so you would pay 1,17,000 rupees. Would you like me to book your free site survey now?
No, it is still too expensive for us.
We also have EMI available from 2,999 rupees per month for 48 months.
Okay, what is the monthly EMI again?
The monthly EMI is 2,999 rupees per month for 48 months.
Fine, book the free survey. My name is Kiran, I live in Velachery, Saturday works.
Your details are noted for the team to confirm the Saturday survey.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
